subtitle: Lesson 12 · Writing Data

code:
INSERT INTO dbo.LessonDemo (ProductName, ListPrice, Color)
VALUES
    ('Trail Bike', 799.99, 'Red'),
    ('Road Bike', 1199.00, 'Blue'),
    ('Mountain Bike', 1499.50, 'Black');
caption: The column list is written once and applies to every tuple that follows.

code:
VALUES
    ('Hybrid Bike', 950.00, NULL),
    ('Touring Bike', 1050.00, 'Green');   -- no trailing comma
caption: A missing or extra comma is a syntax error for the WHOLE statement.
Combining rows into one statement cuts parse/compile/round-trip overhead.
One bad tuple blocks EVERY row in that INSERT, not just the bad one.

subtitle: Inserting rows pulled from a query instead of literals.
